payload.description:
## Intent

Create one distinctive Chatticus identity across the public marketing site and the product workspace. Lead with the existing control-first position, make named teammates feel present through Vultus-driven stateful motion, and establish a reusable visual system that is original rather than derivative of any third-party avatar design.

## Definition of Done

- The marketing site runs as its own Next.js surface at chattic.us and the product app remains at app.chattic.us.
- The public site clearly explains named teammates, the shared user-controlled computer, approvals, skills, routines, and work that can continue while the user is away.
- Vultus is used as a primary brand expression with motion tied to meaningful teammate states.
- The visual identity, typography, color, layout, and motion system are responsive, accessible, and shared with the app.
- No third-party character asset or imitated silhouette is shipped without verified reuse rights and attribution.
- Marketing and app tests, lint, builds, visual checks, and reduced-motion behavior pass.
- The work is reviewed and integrated into develop before the epic closes.
payload.title: Reimagine the Chatticus brand and web experience
